# Vendored: Nous Research Hermes Agent

Pinned release: **v0.20.4** (`v2026.8.18`)  
Commit: `e624e9fde561e1add9388384012b295fde669ade`  
Source: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent

This directory is a sparse snapshot of the Hermes Agent spine Mesh Bot uses:

- `LICENSE`, `README.md`, `pyproject.toml` (version pin `0.20.4`)
- `apps/desktop/package.json` and `apps/desktop/src/plugins/README.md`
- `apps/desktop/src/plugins/hermes-bots/` — in-tree Bot Mode (roster, avatars, routines, bot-to-bot)

The archived plugin https://github.com/NousResearch/Hermes-Bot-Mode is a reference only. Bot Mode development continues in this in-tree plugin.

Do not treat this folder as a second product. MeshVault branding, Qwen / DeepSeek / `MESHBOT_GATEWAY_*`, and the $49 skills path stay in the Mesh Bot application above this vendor tree.
